annotations.text:
MEC Trading — design canvas

Matches the built Next.js app pixel-for-pixel: Fraunces italic display, Inter body, IBM Plex Mono labels; charcoal #17140F, ivory #F7F2E7, gold #B08D57, hunter #1F3327; square corners, 4:5 horse cards, mono uppercase eyebrows.

New on Home: hover a discipline in Our Selection to preview the horses available in it — the card auto-rotates between horses every few seconds, with age, height, level, price and one achievement per card.

Catalog: the discipline chips filter live; horses can belong to more than one discipline (e.g. Competition Horses cross-lists active campaigners).

Detail page: media tabs and the pedigree's Show more generations are clickable.

Horse names, prices and results are sample data from the app's seed file. EN shown; FR / AR reuse the app's field-level translations (AR fully RTL).

Owner-only admin (single seller — no marketplace features).

Sidebar sections: Dashboard, Horses, Inquiries, Media Library, Pedigrees, Site Content, SEO, Settings.

Inquiry pipeline: New → Contacted → Qualified → Viewing Scheduled → Sold / Closed.

Featured toggle controls which horses appear on the homepage.
